entries.task_id: esma|should|ensure that pricing policies
entries.description: ESMA should ensure that pricing policies
entries.subject: ESMA
entries.object: ensure that pricing policies

spans.text: (2) In order to mitigate conflicts of interest and facilitate fair competition in the credit rating market, ESMA should ensure that pricing policies, procedures and ultimately fees charged by credit rating agencies to clients are not discriminatory.

entries.task_id: of service|should|be justifiable by a difference in the actual costs in providing the service to different clients
entries.description: of service should be justifiable by a difference in the actual costs in providing the service to different clients
entries.subject: of service
entries.object: be justifiable by a difference in the actual costs in providing the service to different clients

spans.text: Differences in fees charged for the same type of service should be justifiable by a difference in the actual costs in providing the service to different clients.

entries.task_id: given issuer|should|not depend on the results or outcome of the work performed
entries.description: given issuer should not depend on the results or outcome of the work performed
entries.subject: given issuer
entries.object: not depend on the results or outcome of the work performed

spans.text: Moreover, the fees charged for credit rating services to a given issuer should not depend on the results or outcome of the work performed.

entries.task_id: rating agencies|should|allow esma to identify credit ratings that would require more in-depth scrutiny and possible further supervisory follow-up actions
entries.description: rating agencies should allow ESMA to identify credit ratings that would require more in-depth scrutiny and possible further supervisory follow-up actions
entries.subject: rating agencies
entries.object: allow ESMA to identify credit ratings that would require more in-depth scrutiny and possible further supervisory follow-up actions

spans.text: (3) The fee information to be submitted by registered credit rating agencies should allow ESMA to identify credit ratings that would require more in-depth scrutiny and possible further supervisory follow-up actions.

entries.task_id: similar fees|should|be charged for credit ratings and ancillary services with similar features
entries.description: Similar fees should be charged for credit ratings and ancillary services with similar features
entries.subject: Similar fees
entries.object: be charged for credit ratings and ancillary services with similar features

spans.text: Similar fees should be charged for credit ratings and ancillary services with similar features, differences in fee levels being justified on the basis of cost differences.

entries.task_id: information collected|should|allow esma to identify
entries.description: information collected should allow ESMA to identify
entries.subject: information collected
entries.object: allow ESMA to identify

spans.text: The information collected should allow ESMA to identify, for each registered credit rating agency, comparable services and their respective fees and therefore to detect any significant deviations in fees charged.

entries.task_id: esma|can|thereafter undertake investigations to verify that any such fees are set according to lawful pricing policies and procedures and differences in fee levels based on cost differences are consistent with the principles of fair competition
entries.description: ESMA can thereafter undertake investigations to verify that any such fees are set according to lawful pricing policies and procedures and differences in fee levels based on cost differences are consistent with the principles of fair competition
entries.subject: ESMA
entries.object: thereafter undertake investigations to verify that any such fees are set according to lawful pricing policies and procedures and differences in fee levels based on cost differences are consistent with the principles of fair competition

spans.text: ESMA can thereafter undertake investigations to verify that any such fees are set according to lawful pricing policies and procedures and differences in fee levels based on cost differences are consistent with the principles of fair competition, are not due to conflicts of interest and do not depend on the results or outcome of the work performed.

entries.task_id: and procedures|should|be reported for each rating type
entries.description: and procedures should be reported for each rating type
entries.subject: and procedures
entries.object: be reported for each rating type

spans.text: (4) Pricing policies and procedures should be reported for each rating type.

(8) Pricing policies and procedures should be provided on an ongoing basis so that any material changes are reported without undue delay after their adoption and at the latest 30 days after their implementation.

entries.task_id: and procedures|should|have an identification number
entries.description: and procedures should have an identification number
entries.subject: and procedures
entries.object: have an identification number

spans.text: For reporting purposes and in order to clearly distinguish each pricing policy and procedure and their respective updates, each version of the pricing policies with its respective fee schedules, fee programmes and procedures should have an identification number.

entries.task_id: pricing policies|should|include the fee structures or fee schedules as well as the pricing criteria that can be applied by the person or persons negotiating the fees to be charged for an individual credit rating
entries.description: pricing policies should include the fee structures or fee schedules as well as the pricing criteria that can be applied by the person or persons negotiating the fees to be charged for an individual credit rating
entries.subject: pricing policies
entries.object: include the fee structures or fee schedules as well as the pricing criteria that can be applied by the person or persons negotiating the fees to be charged for an individual credit rating

spans.text: For all other purposes, the pricing policies should include the fee structures or fee schedules as well as the pricing criteria that can be applied by the person or persons negotiating the fees to be charged for an individual credit rating.

The pricing policies should also include any frequency or other fee programmes from which the rated entity or subscriber may benefit in terms of different fees charged for an individual rating or a set of credit ratings.

entries.task_id: rating agencies|should|record all instances of where the pricing policies
entries.description: rating agencies should record all instances of where the pricing policies
entries.subject: rating agencies
entries.object: record all instances of where the pricing policies

spans.text: Credit rating agencies should record all instances of where the pricing policies, fee schedules, fee programmes and procedures have not been applied and all instances of deviations from the pricing policy as applied to an individual credit rating, with a clear identification of the credit rating involved.

entries.task_id: a group|should|be able to either report their ratings data separately to esma or mandate one of the other credit rating agencies within the group to submit the data on behalf of all group members that are subject to the reporting requirements

spans.text: (5) Registered credit rating agencies that are part of a group should be able to either report their ratings data separately to ESMA or mandate one of the other credit rating agencies within the group to submit the data on behalf of all group members that are subject to the reporting requirements.
